principles: Cobalt-base alloys are used where retention of strength, hardness, wear resistance or oxidation resistance at elevated temperature is important.
Thermal conductivity and CTE must be treated as grade- and temperature-dependent inputs.
Thermal cycling can interact with carbide/matrix microstructure and surface damage.
Hot-service selection must include exposure time, not temperature alone.
rule: Do not extrapolate room-temperature mechanical or hardness data into high-temperature service.
